measurement_note: Size is n, the common string length. Each target equals its start and alternates R pieces with blanks, forcing a full successful scan. A linear two-pointer implementation fits the required O(n) bound. A correct implementation that repeatedly searches a stored position list for each coordinate completes all tiers but scales quadratically.
